python - <<'PY'
import contextlib
import io
import operator
import semver

v = semver.VersionInfo('1', '2', '3', 4, 5)
assert tuple(v) == (1, 2, 3, '4', '5')
for name in ('major', 'minor', 'patch', 'prerelease', 'build'):
    try:
        setattr(v, name, 9)
    except AttributeError:
        pass
    else:
        raise AssertionError(name)

v = semver.VersionInfo.parse('1.2.3-rc.1+build.9')
for op in (operator.eq, operator.ne, operator.lt, operator.le, operator.gt, operator.ge):
    for text in ('1.2.3-rc.1', '1.2.3', '1.2.2', '2.0.0'):
        other = semver.VersionInfo.parse(text)
        assert op(v, tuple(other)) == op(v, other)
        assert op(tuple(other), v) == op(other, v)
for other in ('1.2.3', 123):
    assert v != other
    for op in (operator.lt, operator.le, operator.gt, operator.ge):
        try:
            op(v, other)
        except TypeError:
            pass
        else:
            raise AssertionError((op, other))
for part in ('major', 'minor', 'patch', 'prerelease', 'build'):
    method_result = getattr(v, 'bump_' + part)()
    assert isinstance(method_result, semver.VersionInfo)
    assert str(method_result) == getattr(semver, 'bump_' + part)(str(v))
assert str(v) == '1.2.3-rc.1+build.9'
assert str(v.replace(major='2', prerelease=None)) == '2.2.3+build.9'
assert semver.replace(str(v), build=None) == '1.2.3-rc.1'
assert v.replace() is not v
try:
    v.replace(unknown=1)
except TypeError:
    pass
else:
    raise AssertionError('Unknown replacement accepted')

parser = semver.createparser()
assert parser.prog == 'pysemver'
for argv, expected in ((['compare', '1.0.0', '2.0.0'], -1),
                       (['bump', 'patch', '1.2.3'], '1.2.4'),
                       (['check', '1.2.3'], None)):
    assert semver.process(parser.parse_args(argv)) == expected
    with contextlib.redirect_stdout(io.StringIO()):
        assert semver.main(argv) == 0
with contextlib.redirect_stderr(io.StringIO()):
    assert semver.main(['check', 'not-a-version']) == 2
print('All release smoke checks passed')
